macros.name: AfterEndDocument
macros.doc: This hook differs from \AtEndDocument in that the ⟨code⟩ is executed at the very end of the document, after the main aux file (as written on the current LaTeX pass) has been read and after any \AtEndDocument code.

macros.name: AfterEndPreamble
macros.doc: This hook differs from \AtBeginDocument in that the ⟨code⟩ is executed at the very end of \begin{document}, after any \AtBeginDocument code.

macros.name: AfterPreamble
macros.doc: This hook is a variant of \AtBeginDocument which may be used in both the preamble and the document body.

macros.name: appto
macros.doc: This command appends arbitrary ⟨code⟩ to a ⟨hook⟩.

macros.name: apptocmd
macros.doc: This command appends ⟨code⟩ to the replacement text of a ⟨command⟩.

macros.name: AtEndPreamble
macros.doc: This hook differs from \AtBeginDocument in that the ⟨code⟩ is executed right at the end of the preamble, before the main aux file (as written on the previous LaTeX pass) is read and prior to any \AtBeginDocument code.

macros.name: boolfalse
macros.doc: Sets the boolean flag ⟨name⟩ to false.

macros.name: booltrue
macros.doc: Sets the boolean flag ⟨name⟩ to true.

macros.name: csmeaning
macros.doc: Similar to the TeX primitive \meaning but takes a control sequence name as its argument.

macros.name: csshow
macros.doc: Similar to the TeX primitive \show but takes a control sequence name as its argument.

macros.name: csuse
macros.doc: Takes a control sequence name as its argument and forms a control sequence token.

macros.name: defcounter
macros.doc: Assigns a value to a LaTeX ⟨counter⟩ previously initialized with \newcounter.

macros.name: deflength
macros.doc: Assigns a value to a ⟨length⟩ register previously initialized with \newlength.

macros.name: docsvlist
macros.doc: This command loops over a comma-separated list of items and executes the auxiliary command \do for every item in the list, passing the item as an argument.

macros.name: dolistloop
macros.doc: This command loops over all items in a ⟨listmacro⟩ and executes the auxiliary command \do for every item in the list, passing the item as an argument.

macros.name: eappto
macros.doc: This command appends arbitrary ⟨code⟩ to a ⟨hook⟩.

macros.name: expandonce
macros.doc: This command expands a ⟨command⟩ once and prevents further expansion of the replacement text.

macros.name: ifblank
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨string⟩ is blank (empty or spaces), and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifbool
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the state of the boolean flag ⟨name⟩ is true, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifboolexpr
macros.doc: Evaluates the ⟨expression⟩ and executes ⟨true⟩ if it is true, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifdef
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨control sequence⟩ is defined, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifdefcounter
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨control sequence⟩ is a TeX \count register allocated with \newcount, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifdefdimen
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨control sequence⟩ is a TeX \dimen register allocated with \newdimen, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifdefempty
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨control sequence⟩ is defined and is a parameterless macro whose replacement text is empty, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifdefequal
macros.doc: Compares two control sequences and expands to ⟨true⟩ if they are equal in the sense of \ifx, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifdefltxprotect
macros.doc: Executes ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨control sequence⟩ is defined and is a LaTeX protection shell, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifdefmacro
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨control sequence⟩ is defined and is a macro, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifdefparam
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨control sequence⟩ is defined and is a macro with one or more parameters, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifdefprefix
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨control sequence⟩ is defined and is a macro prefixed with \long and/or \protected, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifdefprotected
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨control sequence⟩ is defined and is a macro prefixed with \protected, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifdefstrequal
macros.doc: Performs a category code agnostic string comparison of the replacement text of two commands.

macros.name: ifdefstring
macros.doc: Compares the replacement text of a ⟨command⟩ to a ⟨string⟩ and executes ⟨true⟩ if they are equal, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifdefvoid
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨control sequence⟩ is undefined, or is a control sequence whose meaning is \relax, or is a parameterless macro whose replacement text is empty, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifdimcomp
macros.doc: Compares two dimen expressions according to ⟨relation⟩ and expands to ⟨true⟩ or ⟨false⟩ depending on the result.

macros.name: ifinlist
macros.doc: This command executes ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨item⟩ is included in a ⟨listmacro⟩, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifltxcounter
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if ⟨name⟩ is a LaTeX counter allocated with \newcounter, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifnumcomp
macros.doc: Compares two integer expressions according to ⟨relation⟩ and expands to ⟨true⟩ or ⟨false⟩ depending on the result.

macros.name: ifnumodd
macros.doc: Evaluates an integer expression and expands to ⟨true⟩ if the result is an odd number, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifpatchable
macros.doc: This command executes ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨command⟩ may be patched with \patchcmd and if the ⟨search⟩ pattern is found in its replacement text, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifrmnum
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if ⟨string⟩ is a Roman numeral, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifstrempty
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨string⟩ is empty, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifstrequal
macros.doc: Compares two strings and executes ⟨true⟩ if they are equal, and ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: iftoggle
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the state of the boolean flag ⟨name⟩ is true, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: ifundef
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if the ⟨control sequence⟩ is undefined, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: listadd
macros.doc: This command appends an ⟨item⟩ to a ⟨listmacro⟩.

macros.name: listbreak
macros.doc: You may use \listbreak at the end of the replacement text of \do to stop processing and discard the remaining items in the list.

macros.name: listremove
macros.doc: This command removes an ⟨item⟩ from a ⟨listmacro⟩.

macros.name: newbool
macros.doc: Defines a new boolean flag called ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: newtoggle
macros.doc: Defines a new boolean flag called ⟨name⟩.

macros.name: patchcmd
macros.doc: This command extracts the replacement text of a ⟨command⟩, replaces ⟨search⟩ with ⟨replace⟩, and reassembles the ⟨command⟩.

macros.name: protecting
macros.doc: This command applies LaTeX’s protection mechanism, which normally requires prefixing each fragile command with \protect, to an entire chunk of arbitrary ⟨code⟩.

macros.name: providebool
macros.doc: Defines a new boolean flag called ⟨name⟩ unless it has already been defined.

macros.name: providetoggle
macros.doc: Defines a new boolean flag called ⟨name⟩ unless it has already been defined.

macros.name: robustify
macros.doc: Redefines a ⟨command⟩ defined with \newcommand such that it is robust, without altering its parameters, its prefixes, or its replacement text.

macros.name: setbool
macros.doc: Sets the boolean flag ⟨name⟩ to ⟨value⟩ which may be either true or false.

macros.name: settoggle
macros.doc: Sets the boolean flag ⟨name⟩ to ⟨value⟩ which may be either true or false.

macros.name: togglefalse
macros.doc: Sets the boolean flag ⟨name⟩ to false.

macros.name: toggletrue
macros.doc: Sets the boolean flag ⟨name⟩ to true.

macros.name: tracingpatches
macros.doc: Enables tracing for all patching commands, including \ifpatchable.

macros.name: undef
macros.doc: Clears a ⟨command⟩ such that e-TeX’s \ifdefined and \ifcsname tests will consider it as undefined.

macros.name: unlessboolexpr
macros.doc: Similar to \whileboolexpr but negates the ⟨expression⟩, i. e., it keeps executing the ⟨code⟩ repeatedly unless the expression is true.

macros.name: whileboolexpr
macros.doc: Evaluates the ⟨expression⟩ like \ifboolexpr and repeatedly executes the ⟨code⟩ while the expression is true.
